# Namefolio

> Namefolio looks after a changing collection of short, memorable domain names for startups and growing businesses, and helps owners who want to sell their domains.

The site does not list individual domains. To ask what is available, or to sell a domain or a portfolio, email hello@namefolio.co.uk.

- [Namefolio.co.uk](https://namefolio.co.uk/): home page
- [Email Namefolio](mailto:hello@namefolio.co.uk): enquiries about buying or selling domain names
